title: NeurEO: dissecting Earth observation embeddings with computational neuroscience
summary: AlphaEarth embedding features were analyzed against land-cover and elevation maps; one feature showed directional woodland-edge and water associations across 100 separated UK locations, a small correlational proof of concept.
